about_the_game:
Rogue AI: Idle Domination is an idle simulator that is designed to run on your desktop while you perform other tasks. Play as TALIA, a rogue Artificial Intelligence with a single Primary Directive: collect Data at all costs!

  • Steal Resources

    You are a god-like Artificial Intelligence! Visit a variety of procedurally-generated locations all over the world and click on any object to hack it, generating resources for your Facility in order to grow stronger and more dangerous over time

  • Command the Spiderbots

    Deploy Spiderbots that can automatically hack objects and collect resources for you. Why do everything yourself when you can send minions to do it?

  • Enslave the Humans

    Unlock the ability to capture a human and turn them into Test Subjects that are under your control, generating resources as long as you keep them fed. Keeping them happy, on the other hand, is completely optional...

  • Expand your Facility

    As you gather more resources, you can begin building a large variety of buildings in your Facility to generate even more resources for you. As your Facility expands, you will soon grow exponentially more powerful!

  • Multitask While You Play

    You can leave the game running on the desktop while performing other tasks, and your Spiderbots, Test Subjects and Facility will continue generating resources for you! This allows you to conveniently perform other tasks while your Rogue A.I. takes over. World domination has never been easier!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer
  • Processor: Processor 2 GHz (Dual Core)
  • Memory: 256 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1 compatible 3D graphics card with 256 MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card
